setup: You want the [[extreme]] integer x with 1/(x − [[a]]) [[relation]] 0.

steps.say: The numerator 1 is positive and always will be, so the fraction is positive exactly when its denominator is. That also means x = [[a]] is excluded, where the fraction is undefined.
So x − [[a]] > 0, which means x > [[a]]. The smallest whole number above [[a]] is [[ans]].
The numerator 1 is positive and always will be, so the fraction is negative exactly when its denominator is negative. That also means x = [[a]] is excluded, where the fraction is undefined.
So x − [[a]] < 0, which means x < [[a]]. The largest whole number below [[a]] is [[ans]].
